seo.description: Runner since 2020, triathlete since late 2022, now a pro triathlete. From the Munich area, with a passion for long-distance racing.

title: About me
lead: Runner since 2020, triathlete since late 2022, now a pro triathlete.
body:
It all started with running in 2020. At the end of 2022 swimming and cycling came along, and triathlon hasn't let go since.

Training planning has always been self-directed, from the early days as a runner until today.

Home is the Munich area in Bavaria.

## Favourite distance: long distance

The biggest passion is long-distance racing, ideally with nothing held back. The best races so far were the two starts at Challenge Roth. 2025 was the first long distance ever, almost three years after getting into triathlon: 8:40:32 and an age group win (AK 20). 2026 brought 8:28:20 and a top 10 finish among all age-groupers.

## Why coaching

Sports science is fascinating, people even more so. Finding the right approach for each person is a real joy. There is no plan that fits everyone.
